confidence: High — reproduced at helper and production HTTP API layers
title: ผู้พัฒนาแอปหนึ่งดาวน์โหลดไฟล์ของอีกแอปได้ หากทราบรหัสไฟล์
root: assertFileAccess returns immediately for access.builder, without checking access.datasets, attachment ownership or a readable row reference. The file handler then reads the global _files table. assertImageAccess applies a different, stricter dataset-aware rule.
steps: สร้างไฟล์จำลองผูกกับตารางในแอปต้นทาง
สร้างแอป A แยกและมอบเฉพาะสิทธิ์พัฒนาแอป A ให้บัญชีจำลอง โดยไม่เชื่อมตารางต้นทาง
Login บัญชีดังกล่าวและเลือกแอป A
เรียก API ตารางต้นทาง แล้วเรียก /api/files/<synthetic-id> ด้วย session เดียวกัน
expected: ทั้งตารางและไฟล์ที่ไม่อยู่ในขอบเขตแอปต้องตอบ 403
actual: ตารางตอบ 403 แต่ไฟล์ตอบ 200 และ bytes ตรงกับข้อมูลจำลอง
impact: Cross-app confidentiality boundary fails for attachments; a UUID is not an authorization boundary. Requires an authenticated app developer and knowledge of an attachment ID. No live attachment or real account was accessed.
fix: Apply dataset-aware authorization for developers, like the image path. Require an authorized reference in the active app, or a narrowly scoped upload-owner/provenance exception for unfinished uploads. Preserve explicitly shared table access and owner-only central management.
regression: Developer A vs file B (known ID); ordinary reader row allow/deny; shared-table file; own pending upload; revoked membership; default/PWA simultaneous apps; malformed/missing ID.

title: Login สำเร็จก็นับเข้าขีดจำกัดส่วนกลาง จนทุกบัญชีถูกบล็อกได้
root: throttle increments a global bucket for every validly formed login request. Successful login clears only the per-account hashed scope; global remains. The public bucket is shared across accounts and IPs for 15 minutes. Password-change validation also calls login.
steps: เริ่มฐานข้อมูลจำลองใหม่และสร้างบัญชีที่ใช้งานได้
Login ด้วยข้อมูลที่ถูกต้องซ้ำ 20 ครั้ง
Login ครั้งที่ 21 ก่อนครบเวลา bucket
expected: Successful logins should not exhaust a shared failed-login quota and deny unrelated legitimate users
actual: 20 successes; the next request returns 429; global bucket count is 20
impact: Availability failure and a shared public denial-of-login mechanism; normal aggregate traffic can trigger it. The reported experiment used successful logins only, not a production flood.
fix: Separate failed-attempt rate limits per account and trusted client identity/IP, with a deliberate aggregate abuse budget. Do not retain successful requests as failures. Keep atomic updates and generic error responses; verify reverse-proxy client identity before trusting forwarded headers.
regression: More than 20 aggregate successful logins; success after prior failures; distinct users/IPs; one abusive account must not lock all users; password-change validation; concurrent failed attempts and expiry.

severity: P1 High; potential P0 impact on affected Windows production deployments
confidence: High for vulnerable installed versions; application exploitability NOT TESTED
title: Next.js และ PostCSS รุ่นที่ติดตั้งอยู่ใน affected ranges ของ security advisories
root: The lockfile and installed dependencies resolve Next.js 14.2.15 and PostCSS 8.4.31. npm audit --omit=dev reports 1 critical and 1 high vulnerable package. These are dependency findings, not proof that every advisory is exploitable in this app.
steps: ใช้ package/lockfile ของสำเนาแยกโดยไม่ install/fix
รัน npm.cmd audit --omit=dev --ignore-scripts --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --json
เทียบ affected versions กับ vendor advisories
expected: Production dependency gate contains no unresolved advisories applicable to the deployment
actual: Registry audit flags 2 vulnerable packages (critical: 1, high: 1). Vendor Windows RCE advisory includes this Next version; vendor middleware advisory also includes it.
impact: Potential framework-level security impact depends on OS and enabled paths. The repository checks sessions/rights in API handlers as well as routing, so middleware advisory presence alone does NOT prove bypass of those API checks. Windows-specific RCE must not be generalized to Linux.
fix: Plan a supported, fully patched Next/React-compatible target and review migration changes, dynamic route APIs, caching and middleware behavior. Do not blindly run npm audit fix --force or treat one historical 14.x patch as fixing all current advisories. Re-audit and rerun security/E2E gates before rollout.
regression: Unauthenticated and cross-app API matrix; rewritten/PWA routes; action/body limits; cache behavior; Docker build and native dependency compatibility on the actual Linux target. Destructive exploit tests require a separate approved lab.

confidence: High for failed assertions; underlying runtime paths after failure remain untested
title: E2E เดิม 4 ชุดไม่ตรงกับ contract ของ UI ปัจจุบัน ทำให้ทดสอบไม่ครบ
root: Selectors still expect the legacy users heading/global role cards and an exact attachment href without the application query parameter. Current routing centralizes user management; AttachmentValue builds scoped URLs through appResourceUrl.
steps: รัน production integration modes permissions, workflows, exceloptions แยกฐานข้อมูล
สังเกต assertion ที่รอ heading, legacy role card และ exact attachment link
expected: Selected suites finish all current behavior assertions and fail only on an actual contract regression
actual: Three legacy selector timeouts and one legacy builder Automation-skipped expectation failure; downstream checks are incomplete.
impact: Reduced regression protection and noisy gates. This finding is a test-maintenance failure, not proof that the three product features are broken.
fix: After approval, update navigation/selectors against the intended UI contract; assert semantic attachment role/name and parsed scoped URL. Keep authorization assertions and cover the per-app role workflow rather than removing checks to get a green result.
regression: All 3 full suites must complete after approved changes; intentionally remove permissions/file target to ensure tests still fail.

confidence: High — browser and authorized API compared on synthetic rows
title: แท็บที่เลือกจาก เพิ่มเติม แสดงจำนวนเป็น 0 แม้มีข้อมูล
root: The visible chip set is sliced to 50. For a selected value outside this set, the fallback explicitly replaces selected.count with 0 whenever data.total is available. This discards the valid count fetched in the full options/more results.
steps: สร้าง View ตารางที่มีคอลัมน์แท็บ 60 ค่าไม่ซ้ำ แต่ละค่ามี 1 แถว
เปิด เพิ่มเติม แล้วเลือกค่า State 55
เทียบ badge ของชิปกับ option_counts API
expected: Badge is 1, equal to its source count
actual: API count is 1; selected chip badge is 0
evidence: [Browser/API evidence](evidence/tabs-reproduction.json); screenshot retained in isolated audit artifacts (synthetic data only)
impact: Incorrect UI state and misleading counts for high-cardinality tab columns. Row filtering still works in the reproduced case.
fix: Use the latest matching count from the source/more option; distinguish a confirmed missing value from a value omitted by the 50/500 display cap. Invalidate stale selected counts on data revision without forcing a known value to zero.
regression: Selection 51–500; server-searched option beyond 500; refresh after count change; deleted selected value; empty values; Slice/row permissions; both table and list layouts.

confidence: High — unknown mode executed and returned a successful API test summary
title: สะกดชื่อ integration mode ผิด แต่ runner กลับรายงานผล API ชุดอื่นผ่าน
root: Unknown process.argv[2] values fall through to the default API test list. There is no allowlist rejection or explicit api/default distinction.
steps: รัน node scripts/integration.cjs readonlyaudit ซึ่งไม่มีใน browserTests
อ่านชนิด test ที่ถูกรันและผลคำสั่ง
expected: Unknown mode exits nonzero and lists accepted modes; no substitute suite is silently counted
actual: The runner executes default API tests: 15 passed / 0 failed. The originally mistyped applicationroles command behaved the same; correct approles was run separately.
impact: CI and manual audits can falsely believe a requested feature suite passed. These fallback runs were excluded from coverage in this report.
fix: Reject unknown names explicitly. Preserve deliberate no-argument/api behavior; print the selected file list/mode before execution and emit structured suite identity and status.
regression: Known mode; explicit api; no argument as documented; misspelling/unknown mode must exit nonzero before launching tests.

module: M13 PDF User fields / M24 Performance
confidence: High for measured query amplification; production latency under load NOT TESTED
title: การ resolve ชื่อ User ซ้ำทำ N+1 queries จำนวนมากในรายงาน PDF
root: userFieldLabel calls userFieldOptions for every label. userFieldOptions reads all active users and performs app-access/profile lookups for each. The PDF value renderer calls userFieldLabel separately for User cells. Excel already builds a user map once and is not assumed to have the same per-cell behavior.
steps: สร้างผู้ใช้จำลอง 100 รายในฐานข้อมูล memory
นับ SQL statements โดยไม่บันทึก SQL หรือค่าผู้ใช้
เรียก userFieldLabel 20 ครั้งภายใต้ scope เดียวกัน
expected: Resolve an authorized lookup map once per request/report; repeated labels should not rescan the user catalog
actual: 12,020 SQL statements for 20 labels; 118 ms in the local synthetic run
evidence: [Measured query counts](evidence/performance-reproductions.json) DR-001a; PDF call site lib/pdf-report.ts:21
impact: Repeated synchronous queries amplify cost as users and PDF User cells grow. The measurement establishes query amplification; it is not a claimed production throughput/SLA result.
fix: Build an authorized User label map once per report/request; batch profile and membership queries. Scope any cache by database/application/user/permissions and never use a global unkeyed authorization cache.
regression: Report with many repeated/different User cells and 100+ users; assert a query budget scaling with users plus cells rather than users times cells; inactive/revoked/cross-app users remain hidden.
